<issue_description>
Heap-based buffer overflow (out-of-bounds read) in PackLinuxElf64::elf_lookup (p_lx_elf.cpp). While processing crafted/malformed ELF string table data, strcmp can read past the end of the mapped file buffer, causing a one-byte heap read beyond the allocation. This can crash UPX or lead to memory disclosure when handling malicious ELF files.
